image_summary: Annotated 3D rendering of a secret-knock door lock mounted on a vertical wood-plank door. The lock housing has a transparent front cover so the internal Arduino, battery pack, motor driver, vertical DC motor, vertical drive shaft, brass main gear, blue rack gear, and sliding bolt are all visible. The right side of the image contains a 7-step System Flow legend; the bottom contains an Electrical Flow legend, a Lock States diagram, and a Mechanical Close-Up of the gear/rack engagement.

scene_layout.housing_position: Center-left of the door, mounted on the surface, with door frame visible to the right.

legend_panels.title: MECHANICAL CLOSE-UP
legend_panels.description: Detail view: vertical motor shaft drives gear → gear rotates → rack moves → bolt retracts.

design_constraints_for_simulation: Motor shaft must be visible and share the same vertical axis as the gear hub.
Gear teeth must be visible and engage a horizontal rack.
Rack and bolt must move together horizontally.
Bolt must visibly seat into a strike plate on the door frame.
Color coding must match the legend (blue/yellow/green/black).
A System Flow side panel must mirror the reference legend.
A LOCKED / UNLOCKED indicator must be visible.
